Programming Projects Catalogue

These were all built with Scratch and compiled to JavaScript with TurboWarp Packager. The date in brackets is when it was shared on Scratch.

1. iush (Aug 2026)



Standing for Interactive User Shell, iush is a fully functional virtual command-line environment, featuring custom string parsing, chainable terminal commands, and built-in apps: Notepad, Paint, and Domemory - a spaced repetition tool powered by a pre-trained SuperMemo-5 algorithm to retain lots of information quickly!

Initialize iush now!

2. Ruminations of Reverious Recurrences (Feb 2026)



An epistemological, full-length narrative-driven RPG where discovery is the greatest mystery: Unravel your true identity through the four fields full of fights! Strategize how to survive complex status effects and take on tactical turn-based combat in your quest for discovery!

Role-play in Ruminations of Reverious Recurrences now!

3. The Wanderer (Apr 2023)



A retro 3D dungeon crawler that blends classic exploration with RPG design elements! Explore mind-meander mazes and eerie caves, manage your health and gold, and take on tough boss battles in a 3D raycasted environment!


Wander through The Wanderer now!

4. Perturbing penance (Jul 2026)



Traditional grid-based roguelike inspired by Mystery Dungeon roguelikes, with Emojis as the GUI! Designed so you level up as a player, not just your in-game stats - featuring turn-based tile movement, permadeath, and resource management to reach the top floor and defeat the ultimate evil!

Ponder through Perturbing penance now!

5. The Haunted House (May 2022)



A first-person arcade-style stealth game where you're trapped inside a mansion infested with scary monsters! Navigate the haunted house and collect as much candy as you can, while trying to survive as long as possible for the highest score possible!

Experience The Haunted House now!
